name: Red Planet Observation Log
effects:
On Planet Attack hit, damage increases in proportion to Burn tick damage
The higher the Artifact grade, the greater the increase
- Common: Burn 1-tick damage
- Advanced : Burn 2-tick damage
- Rare : Burn 3-tick damage
- Legendary : Burn 4-tick damage
